review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped its uses. None of the declarations carry simp attributes. The two `_symm` iff lemmas swap the arguments of `vsub`, so marking them simp would risk looping. They are used only through explicit `rw`, in Altitude.lean and in this file. The four `inner_vsub_vsub_*_iff` lemmas and the Pythagorean and `lineMap` distance lemmas are conditional, shape-specific rewrites, and I found no evidence that simp use would help. The internal `simp only` calls are explicit and terminate. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, wrong orientation, competing rule or credible cycle. I did not check whether other files already cover these rewrites.
